description: This PHP file defines the Text class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for text manipulation and analysis such as length calculation, comparison, splitting, and formatting of strings.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Provides static methods for string manipulation, comparison, splitting, and formatting within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string or each string in an array, returning the result with matching dimensions.

methods.name: exact
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive comparison between two text values or arrays of values, returning true if they are exactly the same.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Returns the string value if input is a string; otherwise, returns an empty string or an array of such results.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits text into an array based on specified row and column delimiters with options for ignoring empty cells, case sensitivity, and padding.

methods.name: applyPadding
methods.description: Private method that applies padding to the result of split to ensure consistent dimensions across rows.

methods.name: buildDelimiter
methods.description: Constructs a regex pattern for delimiters, supporting multiple delimiters passed as an array.

methods.name: matchFlags
methods.description: Returns the regex flags based on case sensitivity mode.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D array of values into a string, with optional formatting modes.

methods.name: formatValueMode0
methods.description: Formats a cell value for output when not in formula string mode, converting booleans and other types.

methods.name: formatValueMode1
methods.description: Formats a cell value for output in formula string mode, quoting strings and converting booleans.
